---
title: "Argentina"
subtitle: "Cómo votó Argentina en la Asamblea General, gobierno por gobierno (1946-2026)"
---

```{r}
source("_comun.R")
```

## Votos por gobierno

```{r}
votos_gov |>
  filter(topic == "Todos") |>
  mutate(government = factor(government, levels = rev(orden_gob)),
         etiqueta = paste0(government, if_else(type == "de facto", " (de facto)", ""), "  n=", n_votes)) |>
  plot_ly(y = ~government, orientation = "h", type = "bar",
          x = ~pct_yes, name = "A favor", marker = list(color = COLORES_VOTO[["A favor"]]),
          text = ~etiqueta, hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>%{x:.1f}%<extra>A favor</extra>") |>
  add_trace(x = ~pct_abstain, name = "Abstención", marker = list(color = COLORES_VOTO[["Abstención"]]),
            hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>%{x:.1f}%<extra>Abstención</extra>") |>
  add_trace(x = ~pct_no, name = "En contra", marker = list(color = COLORES_VOTO[["En contra"]]),
            hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>%{x:.1f}%<extra>En contra</extra>") |>
  layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "", ticksuffix = "%", range = c(0, 100)),
         yaxis = list(title = ""), legend = list(orientation = "h"), margin = list(l = 10))
```

## Con quién coincidió

```{r}
refs <- c("EE. UU.", "Reino Unido", "Francia", "URSS/Rusia", "China", "Cuba", "Brasil", "Chile", "México", "Uruguay")
m <- coin_gov |>
  mutate(government = factor(government, levels = rev(orden_gob)), reference = factor(reference, levels = refs)) |>
  arrange(government, reference)

plot_ly(m, x = ~reference, y = ~government, z = ~pct_agreement, type = "heatmap",
        colorscale = list(c(0, "#b2182b"), c(0.55, "#f7f7f7"), c(1, "#2166ac")), zmin = 0, zmax = 100,
        hovertemplate = "%{y} y %{x}: %{z:.0f}%<extra></extra>", colorbar = list(title = "%")) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = ""))
```

## Todas las votaciones

```{r}
nombres_gob <- setNames(gov$government, gov$gov_id)
av |>
  transmute(Fecha = d, Resolución = s, Título = t, Tema = tp,
            `Voto de Argentina` = recode(v, yes = "A favor", no = "En contra", abstain = "Abstención",
                                         absent = "Ausente", non_member = "No miembro"),
            `Sí` = y, `No` = n, `Abst.` = a, Gobierno = nombres_gob[g]) |>
  arrange(desc(Fecha)) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            options = list(pageLength = 15, language = list(search = "Buscar:")))
```
